name: SVC_BI_HCM_PERSON_REF_MAP
description: Captures person data from HCM tables, adding useful attributes needed for BI reporting.

columns.name: PERSON_REF_MAP_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifies person holding an assignment or a set of Employment/Placement Terms.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Loaded from PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.ASSIGNMENT_ID. Identifies the assignment.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Loaded from PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.BUSINESS_UNIT_ID. Identifies business unit.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Loaded from PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.ORGANIZATION_ID. Identifies the organization.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE
columns.description: Loaded from PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_TYPE. Identifies the status of the assignment.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Loaded from PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.ASSIGNMENT_TYPE. Identifies the type of record: either assignment (employee, CWK, applicant, non-workers) or a set of Terms.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE_CE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the assignment type refers to Employee or Contingent Worker. Value is 'Y' if ASSIGNMENT_TYPE in ('E','C') and 'N' otherwise.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifies the party id corresponding to person id.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
